init_abstract_tokenizer: create a subclass of AbstractTokenizer that initializes with a config dictionary containing an accelerator key
implement_tokenize_method: implement the tokenize method in a subclass to process datasets into token sequences
implement_init_tokenizer: implement the _init_tokenizer method in a subclass to set up the tokenizer and eos token
get_padding_token: access the padding_token property which returns 0 as the default padding token value
log_message: call the log method to log a message at a specified level using the utils log function
